allSyllabusUnits.title: Introduction to VLSI Design
allSyllabusUnits.topics: Historical perspective, VLSI design flow, Design Methodologies, Y- chart, Full custom design, standard cell based design, FPGA based 2 Manufacturing Process of CMOS digital IC 04 design Silicon wafer, Photolithography, Simplified process sequences, process flow for fabrication of n-type MOS transistor, CMOS n-well process, 3 MOS Transistor 07 Layout design rules MOS structure, MOS system under external bias and energy band diagram, Understanding accumulation, depletion and inversion, Marwadi University Faculty of Diploma studies Information and Communication Technology Structure and operation of MOS transistor, MOSFET current-voltage

allSyllabusUnits.topics: Introduction, CMOS SR latch based on 2-input NOR gates, CMOS SR latch based on 2-input NAND gates, Clocked SR latch, Clocked JK latch, JK Master-Slave flip-flops, CMOS D-latch and edge triggered D-flip-flop
